svg.title: From a media request to the screen
svg.desc: Seerr passes a film or show request to Radarr or Sonarr. They choose a release using Jackett to search the configured indexers, then send the download to qBittorrent. Unpackerr extracts archives. Radarr or Sonarr hardlinks the completed file from /data/torrents/ into /data/media/ on the same filesystem. The file exists once and seeding continues. Jellyfin finds it on its next scan and plays it.
svg.text: One file on disk · seeding continues
